---
title: "TF Enrichment - Stress Signaling Gene Sets (mitch)"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# Paths relative to this Rmd's location (Adriana_analysis/scripts/)
project_dir <- ".."
load(file.path(project_dir, "project_functions.rda"))

paths       <- setup_project_paths(project_dir)
tables_dir  <- paths$tables_dir
figures_dir <- paths$figures_dir
output_dir  <- paths$output_dir
```

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(mitch)

select <- dplyr::select

# Shared colour palette for dissertation figures
load(file.path(project_dir, "project_colours.rda"))
```

```{r load-pca}
# PC scores: PC1/PC2 only (PC4+ confirmed as noise)
pca_genes <- read_tsv(file.path(tables_dir, "PCA_genes_AC.txt"),
                      show_col_types = FALSE)

mitch_input <- pca_genes %>%
  select(gene_id, PC1, PC2) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene_id")

cat("PC input:", nrow(mitch_input), "genes x", ncol(mitch_input), "contrasts\n")
```

```{r load-genesets}
# Stress signaling gene sets built by 00b_add_stress_signaling_genesets.R:
# GCN2 targets/regulators, SNF1 targets, RTG targets, Gis1 targets, and a
# literature-curated Tod6/Dot6 set (independent of the YEASTRACT-based set
# used in scripts 00/06/07). Presence/absence gene sets only - no
# activated/repressed direction, since the source data has no log2FC.
load(file.path(tables_dir, "stress_signaling_genesets.rda"))

# GCN2_regulators has only 4 genes, below the pipeline's usual minimum of 5 -
# excluded from testing here rather than passed to mitch with too few genes
# to give a meaningful effect size.
genesets_stress <- stress_signaling_genesets[
  map_int(stress_signaling_genesets, length) >= 5
]

cat("Stress signaling gene sets tested:\n")
for (nm in names(genesets_stress)) {
  cat(" ", nm, ":", length(genesets_stress[[nm]]), "genes\n")
}
```

```{r check-gene-overlap}
# Sanity check: confirm reasonable overlap between PCA genes and gene set
# members before running enrichment
pca_gene_ids <- rownames(mitch_input)
overlap <- length(intersect(pca_gene_ids, unlist(genesets_stress)))

cat("Genes in PCA:", length(pca_gene_ids), "\n")
cat("PCA genes found in stress signaling gene sets:", overlap, "\n")
```

```{r run-mitch}
# mitch enrichment, matching script 05's approach (priority = "effect"
# ranks by s.dist). No FDR filter applied yet since only 5 gene sets are
# being tested (multiple testing correction is stricter with few tests,
# so results are inspected in full rather than only the significant subset).
cat("Running mitch: stress signaling gene sets\n")

mitch_stress <- mitch_calc(
  x        = mitch_input,
  genesets = genesets_stress,
  priority = "effect",
  cores    = 1
)

mitch_stress_result <- mitch_stress$enrichment_result %>%
  arrange(p.adjustMANOVA)

print(mitch_stress_result)

n_sig <- sum(mitch_stress_result$p.adjustMANOVA < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
cat("\nSignificant gene sets (FDR < 0.05):", n_sig, "of", nrow(mitch_stress_result), "\n")
```

```{r plot-2d, fig.width=10, fig.height=9}
# 2D scatter of s.PC1 vs s.PC2 effect sizes, matching script 05's plot_tf_2d
plot_stress_2d <- function(df, title) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = s.PC1, y = s.PC2)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = -log10(p.adjustMANOVA)), size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = project_colours[["grey"]]) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = project_colours[["grey"]]) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = set), size = 3, max.overlaps = 20) +
    scale_color_gradient(low = project_colours[["grey"]], high = project_colours[["red"]]) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Effect size PC1 (s.PC1)",
      y = "Effect size PC2 (s.PC2)",
      color = expression(-log[10]("adj. p-value"))
    ) +
    theme_bw()
}

if (!requireNamespace("ggrepel", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("ggrepel")
library(ggrepel)

p_stress_2d <- plot_stress_2d(mitch_stress_result, "Stress signaling gene sets - mitch 2D (PC1 vs PC2)")
print(p_stress_2d)
```

```{r save-outputs}
write_tsv(mitch_stress_result, file.path(output_dir, "tf_mitch_stress_signaling.txt"))

ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, "tf_mitch_stress_signaling_2d.png"),
       plot = p_stress_2d, width = 10, height = 9)

cat("Done - results saved to output_tables/ and figures/\n")
```
